title: FP8 resilient rollforward and recalibration playground for E4M3/E5M2
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Goal: Build a small, reproducible playground that lets us safely rollforward FP8 profiles (E4M3/E5M2) on a subset of Hopper capacity and validate stability/accuracy before broader enablement. This ticket captures the end-to-end flow: automated per-shard recalibration, sampling-based accuracy checks, variance-based drift detection, and rollforward decision logic with conservative fallbacks.

Motivation: Recent FP8 enablement experiments show promising throughput wins but intermittent accuracy drift on long-tail prompts and compositional cases. We need an environment that mirrors production traffic shape while giving us deterministic controls to stress per-layer scaling heuristics and hysteresis.

Scope (what we will deliver):
- A deployable "recalibration playground" service that: orchestrates calibration runs for model shards (per-GPU), records per-op scaling factors, and stores calibration snapshots tagged by model-version + golden-seed.
- Canary harness to shadow a small % of traffic through FP8 variants with synchronized golden scoring to detect semantic regressions.
- Offline batch validator that runs: BLEU/ROUGE/EM-like metrics (where applicable), embedding-similarity drift, and a lightweight LM perplexity delta on prompt subsets.
- Telemetry dashboards (token-level drift histograms, per-op scale distributions, entropy spikes) and automated alerts for defined regression thresholds.
- Rollforward decision engine with explicit gates: smoke checks (latency/oom), accuracy gates (delta thresholds), and stability gates (variance and hysteresis).
- Playbook for manual intervention and automated rollback, including canary size ramp plan and segment-based isolation (customer vs internal).

Non-goals: full fleet-wide FP8 enablement, long-term continuous recalibration service (this is an iterative playground to inform that work).

Key trade-offs considered:
- Safety vs throughput: we bias the initial gates to avoid false positives (i.e., conservative thresholds) at the cost of slower ramp.
- Per-layer scaling frequency: frequent recalibration reduces drift but increases compute costs. We'll evaluate a hybrid schedule (daily light + weekly full).
- Golden sample coverage: complete coverage expensive; we'll use stratified sampling focused on prompts that historically expose quantization sensitivity (long context, numeric-heavy, code-like).
acceptance_criteria: Playground can run a full per-shard FP8 calibration and produce a tagged snapshot within a reproducible CI job
Canary harness can route 0.5% of traffic to FP8 variant and collect synchronous golden scores without adding >8ms median latency to production path
Automated validator produces a pass/fail signal based on pre-defined metric deltas and stores result in the dashboard
Rollforward decision engine can automatically abort ramp and trigger rollback when stability gates breach
Telemetry surfaces a minimum set of signals: per-op scale distribution, token-level delta histogram, and request sample of top-10 regressions
verification_plan: Run CI job using a canonical tiny model (sanity-model) to validate the orchestration path
Execute a staged canary on staging cluster with synthetic traffic (long-tail + numeric prompts) and verify metrics against baseline
Cross-validate embedding-similarity for 10k golden prompts and ensure mean cosine delta within threshold
Stress test recalibration under concurrent canaries to validate resource isolation and time-to-calibrate SLA
rollout_plan: Day 0: Deploy playground to staging, run integration smoke (sanity-model)
Day 1: Shadow 0.1% of internal traffic, collect telemetry for 48h
Day 3: Ramp to 0.5% if no gates tripped, run full batch validator overnight
Day 6: Decision checkpoint — manual review + automated pass -> expand canary to 2% on dedicated pool; fail -> rollback to fp32 for canary pool and capture diagnostics
Day 14: Summarize findings and propose production enablement thresholds / calibration cadence
